'''Zabra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She sold [[Starship/Legends|starship]] components in the [[Rhu Caenus Spaceport]] while being stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].
